fields.label: Enable Batch Rate Guard
fields.description: Replaces an invalid batch outgoing rate (negative, overflowing, or far above the last inward rate) during posting and reposting.

fields.label: Max Rate vs Last Inward Rate (x)
fields.description: A suspicious batch rate higher than this multiple of the last inward rate of the batch is replaced.

fields.label: Enable Back-date Window
fields.description: Users with the role in Stock Settings > Role Allowed to Edit Frozen Stock are not limited.

fields.label: Purchase Receipt: Max Days Back
fields.description: Purchase Receipts (and Purchase Invoices that update stock) are submitted after QC, so they need a longer window.

fields.label: Other Stock Documents: Max Days Back
Run One-time Match Automatically When a Gap Is Found
fields.description: Runs with the 06:30 check. It rebuilds running balances, Bin and batch records, and commits only if every check passes. GL differences above the tolerance are reported, not changed.

fields.label: Clear Value Left on Zero-qty Batches
fields.description: When a batch is fully issued but still carries a value (batch-wise valuation residue), clear that value on the batch's last outward movement and post a Stock In Hand / Stock Adjustment GL pair on the same voucher. Movements in closed periods (on or before Stock Frozen Up To) are only reported. Switch on only after Accounts approval.

fields.label: Check GL vs Stock Ledger for Last (Days)
Create Repost Entries Automatically
fields.description: For each item-warehouse whose running balance or Bin is out of line, create a Repost Item Valuation from the first wrong entry. For each voucher whose GL differs from the Stock Ledger, create an accounting-only Repost Item Valuation.

fields.label: One-time Match
fields.description: Runs the tested one-time correction from inside the site. Use the buttons at the top: Preview (changes nothing), Apply (commits only if every check passes), Undo (restores the backup).
